''See also: [[The Wanderer Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|The Wanderer, also known as [[Valin]], is a legendary figure who was once human but evolved into something more. He arrived in [[the House]] through a sudden, violent flash of light and sound, appearing as if he had been cast from another location. Upon his arrival, he claimed [[the House]] and renamed it [[Valinhall]]. Through his own expertise and the study of collected books, he created a key to establish a Gate connecting his world to others. He also forged keys for the twelve original soldiers of the [[Dragon Army]] and created the Dragon's Fang{{!}}Dragon's Fangs in his Workshop{{!}}workshop. Physically, he is described with striking and unsettling features, most notably eyes that lack whites; instead, they consist of solid blackness with metallic silver irises. He has been seen appearing as a disheveled figure in stained robes with a long beard, or as a tall man in travel-worn clothing carrying an enormous book. As the Valinhall Incarnation{{!}}Incarnation of Valinhall, he possesses a profound connection to his territory, causing the environment to reshape itself into polished wood and carved structures as he moves. While some [[Travelers]] summon elemental forces or beasts to fight, the nature of [[Valinhall]]'s power is distinct. Though he once held the status of an [[Incarnation]], he has expressed that this power fades over time, eventually leaving him as a mere guardian of the rooms.}}

== History ==

{{spoiler|book=tg-01-house-of-blades|The Wanderer arrived in [[Valinhall]] by falling into the [[entry hall]] amidst a great roar and a flash of light.<ref name="tg-01-house-of-blades-c9">''House of Blades'', chapter 9</ref> Among men, the Wanderer was known by the name [[Valin]].<ref name="tg-01-house-of-blades-c9" /> He also forged the [[Demon Fang]] Azura.<ref name="tg-01-house-of-blades-c13">''House of Blades'', chapter 13</ref>}}

<li>{{spoiler|book=tg-01-house-of-blades|[[The Wanderer]] was known as [[Valin]] among men.<ref name="tg-01-house-of-blades-c9" />}}</li>

{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|During his time in the forge, The Wanderer crafted the Dragon's Fang{{!}}Dragon’s Fangs.<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c2">''The Crimson Vault'', chapter 2</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|Disappearance and Legacy}} ===
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|Following their disappearance, a grave was established for the Wanderer within [[the House]].<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c2" /><ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c4">''The Crimson Vault'', chapter 4</ref> As the original owner of [[Mithra]], the Wanderer once spoke regarding metaphysical distance and how a [[Territory]] links to its powers.<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c9">''The Crimson Vault'', chapter 9</ref><ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c14">''The Crimson Vault'', chapter 14</ref> While the [[Valinhall Travelers]] are destined to face the Wanderer again, [[Kai]] is also referred to by the title of Wanderer.<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c17">''The Crimson Vault'', chapter 17</ref><ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c20">''The Crimson Vault'', chapter 20</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">6</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|[[The Wanderer]] disappeared.<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c2" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|[[The Wanderer]] has a grave in [[the House]].<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c4" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|[[The Wanderer]] is the original owner of [[Mithra]].<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c9" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|[[The Wanderer]] spoke of metaphysical distance and the link between a [[Territory]] and its powers.<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c14" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|The [[Valinhall Travelers]] are set to face the The Wanderer{{!}}Wanderer once again.<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c17" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|[[Kai]] is referred to as a The Wanderer{{!}}Wanderer.<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c20" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

=== {{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Guardian of the Room}} ===
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Formerly a human, The Wanderer eventually transformed into something more.<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c1">''City of Light'', chapter 1</ref> Having ceased to be an [[Incarnation]], the entity now functions as a guardian of the room.<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c5">''City of Light'', chapter 5</ref> During an encounter, The Wanderer questioned [[Simon]] regarding his desires.<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c9">''City of Light'', chapter 9</ref>}}
